## Building a Language Model from Scratch {#building-a-language-model-from-scratch}

A tokenizer, a Transformer, a training loop, and a 45-minute leaderboard run, written from PyTorch primitives while working through Stanford's [CS 336](courses/cs336-language-modeling-from-scratch/index.qmd). Every post is built around numbers I measured.

::: {#llm-series}
:::

## Parallelism in AI {#parallelism-in-ai}

How training is split across many GPUs, from replicating the whole model to slicing weight matrices. Each post is animated and narrated.

::: {#parallelism-series}
:::
